name: Jordan Firstman
bio: Jordan Firstman (born July 8, 1991) is an American writer, producer, and comedian living in Los Angeles, California. He is known for the short films Men Don't Whisper and the Sundance-nominated Call Your Father. Firstman rose to prominence for his short skits, called Impressions, shared on Instagram Live in 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic.
